issues.description: Constructor parameter type for PersonResource is inconsistent between the template (and the problem description) and the solution. The template declares public PersonResource(PersonService personService) (injecting the service), which matches the exercise description that PersonResource should use PersonService. The solution repository instead declares public PersonResource(String personService). This mismatched constructor parameter will prevent Spring from injecting the PersonService bean in the solution, will likely fail to compile or start (or fail bean creation at runtime), and conflicts with the intended design where the REST resource depends on PersonService.
issues.suggested_fix: Change the constructor in the solution's PersonResource to accept a PersonService (matching the template and the intended design). Specifically: public PersonResource(PersonService personService) { this.personService = personService; } This restores correct Spring dependency injection and aligns the solution with the template and problem description.
